name: Etapp 4: BLT Árasluoktastugorna - BLT Stáloluoktastugan
description: BLT Árasluoktastugorna to BLT Stáloluoktastugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF, Naturkartan, Padjelanta.se overview, Padjelanta.se Árasluokta page, and computed BD60/OSM geometry support about 10 km; BLT/Padjelanta Stáloluokta-side pages list Árasluokta as 12 km.
Naturkartan still says shop; BLT says smaller sales may occur; Padjelanta.se says previous Parfas kiosk sales have ceased; OSM still has a Parfas Kiosk node with active-looking tags.

BLT 2026 pricing says card payment is possible in summer at cabin camps; BLT FAQ says provisions are cash-only and prepayment/cash is advised because mountain infrastructure is unreliable; old OSM payment tags are stale.
Naturkartan/OSM route endpoints are offset from hut coordinates at both ends, especially Árasluokta.
No Stage 4 closure was found, but Laponia current-info pages include off-section bridge and temporary seasonal notices that can become stale quickly.
